Abstract

The IT Asset & Support Desk Management System (AssetDesk) is a robust, production-grade enterprise web application engineered to streamline and unify physical IT asset tracking, software license lifecycle management, and internal employee helpdesk ticket resolution.

Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React 18, Node.js), the platform introduces five cohesive functional modules: (M1) Authentication & User Management featuring stateless JWT session issuance, bcrypt password hashing, and tiered Role-Based Access Control (Admin, IT Support, Employee); (M2) Hardware Asset Management incorporating automated tag generation (AST-YYYY-NNNN), atomic assignment, and lifecycle tracking; (M3) Software License Management providing automated seat capacity enforcement, key masking, and proactive 30-day expiry alerting; (M4) Support Desk & SLA Management featuring priority-driven resolution deadlines (4h, 24h, 48h, 72h) and strict state transitions; and (M5) Compliance Audit & Reporting delivering immutable append-only activity tracking, dynamic KPI dashboards, and RFC-4180 compliant CSV data exports.

The system was subjected to exhaustive automated quality assurance, comprising 57 unit tests, 187 integration tests, 12 security tests, and 16 Playwright end-to-end system scenarios, achieving 88.18% line coverage. Performance benchmarking verified sub-10ms response times for core API endpoints. The resulting application offers an extensible, auditable, and secure solution for modern organizational IT operations.
